_llm_instructions: Populate the fields of 'VARIANCE ANALYSIS' and write the value of each field under 'Generated Value', based on the project context. Context: the project carrying reference PMO-06.04.

f01_Schedule_Planned_Result.label: Schedule / Planned Result
f01_Schedule_Planned_Result.guidance: The target baseline schedule milestone, duration, or date.

f02_Schedule_Actual_Result.label: Schedule / Actual Result
f02_Schedule_Actual_Result.guidance: The actual completed milestone date, duration, or current progress.

f03_Schedule_Variance.label: Schedule / Variance
f03_Schedule_Variance.guidance: Calculated difference between actual schedule performance and the baseline.

f04_Schedule_Root_Cause.label: Schedule / Root Cause
f04_Schedule_Root_Cause.guidance: Primary cause and contributing factors for schedule variance.

f05_Schedule_Planned_Response.label: Schedule / Planned Response
f05_Schedule_Planned_Response.guidance: Action plan or recovery strategy designed to address schedule variance.

f06_Cost_Planned_Result.label: Cost / Planned Result
f06_Cost_Planned_Result.guidance: The approved baseline budget or planned expenditure for the period.

f07_Cost_Actual_Result.label: Cost / Actual Result
f07_Cost_Actual_Result.guidance: The actual expenditures or costs incurred during the period.

f08_Cost_Variance.label: Cost / Variance
f08_Cost_Variance.guidance: Calculated difference between actual expenditures and the cost baseline.

f09_Cost_Root_Cause.label: Cost / Root Cause
f09_Cost_Root_Cause.guidance: Primary drivers and events resulting in cost overruns or savings.

f10_Cost_Planned_Response.label: Cost / Planned Response
f10_Cost_Planned_Response.guidance: Corrective measures and cost containment actions to realign with budget.

f11_Quality_Planned_Result.label: Quality / Planned Result
f11_Quality_Planned_Result.guidance: The quality metric, acceptance threshold, or standard expected.

f12_Quality_Actual_Result.label: Quality / Actual Result
f12_Quality_Actual_Result.guidance: The actual measured quality outcome, defect rate, or test score.

f13_Quality_Variance.label: Quality / Variance
f13_Quality_Variance.guidance: Discrepancy between actual quality achievements and defined quality metrics.

f14_Quality_Root_Cause.label: Quality / Root Cause
f14_Quality_Root_Cause.guidance: Root cause analysis detailing why quality requirements were not met.

f15_Quality_Planned_Response.label: Quality / Planned Response
f15_Quality_Planned_Response.guidance: Remediation plan, rework procedures, or process improvements.

f16_Scope_Planned_Result.label: Scope / Planned Result
f16_Scope_Planned_Result.guidance: The authorized deliverables and work packages committed in the scope statement.

f17_Scope_Actual_Result.label: Scope / Actual Result
f17_Scope_Actual_Result.guidance: The actual scope deliverables completed and verified during the period.

f18_Scope_Variance.label: Scope / Variance
f18_Scope_Variance.guidance: Extent of scope variance, unapproved scope additions, or unfinished deliverables.

f19_Scope_Root_Cause.label: Scope / Root Cause
f19_Scope_Root_Cause.guidance: Factors causing scope variance, creep, or delayed deliverable completions.

f20_Scope_Planned_Response.label: Scope / Planned Response
f20_Scope_Planned_Response.guidance: Corrective actions, change requests, or realignment to baseline scope.

f21_Implications_of_continued_variance_F.label: Implications of continued variance (Forecast)
f21_Implications_of_continued_variance_F.guidance: Anticipated long-term impact on overall project objectives if variances persist.

f22_Escalation_Required_Y_N.label: Escalation Required (Y/N)
f22_Escalation_Required_Y_N.guidance: Clear indication (Yes/No) whether senior leadership escalation is necessary.

f23_Escalation_Details.label: Escalation Details
f23_Escalation_Details.guidance: Details of the specific escalation path, required decisions, and target stakeholders.

f24_Comments.label: Comments
f24_Comments.guidance: Additional explanatory notes, cross-functional dependencies, or contextual insights.
